title: QA: uuid major upgrade breaks a deep import
summary: A dependency bump (uuid 3.4.0 -> 9.0.1) removes the deep import path the code uses (alibi-qa controlled scenario).

failingTest.name: newOrderId is prefixed and has 32 hex characters

expected.notes: uuid >= 8 no longer exposes uuid/v4. A model patch to another major version fails validation; the deterministic pin back to 3.4.0 validates.
